supporting_observations.claim: At 13:41:56 UTC, maria.lopez ran PowerShell from her interactive session to compress \\FILE-HD-01\Shared\Clients into C:\Users\maria.lopez\AppData\Local\Temp\c.zip; the ZIP file was created shortly afterward.

At 13:45:24 UTC, maria.lopez launched Chrome to sendbox-files.io. The proxy later recorded a successful CONNECT tunnel to that host with 51,000,000 client-to-server bytes; endpoint network telemetry attributes the proxy connection to the same Chrome process.

The sequence of creating an archive from the Clients share and then sending about 51 MB to sendbox-files.io strongly supports likely data exfiltration. The supplied service inventory says no file-sharing services other than the named approved services are approved, making this destination unapproved in the stated environment.
The evidence does not establish that c.zip was the file transferred: it records the archive's creation and a large outbound tunnel, but does not link the tunnel payload to that file.
